name: Immoral Sister Reo
source:
Main character is an extremely self-centered narcissist and a lewd guy who considers himself   "God's guardian deity". He has a habit of using "ultimate means of loving women". There's been rumor of a bewitching woman lately. Such evil should not remain unpunished. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是个极端自我中心的自恋狂，也是一个好色之徒，自称“神之守护神”。他习惯运用所谓“爱女人的终极手段”。最近，城中流传着关于一名妖艳女子的传闻。这样的邪恶绝不能逍遥法外。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
